title: Conservation of Energy
text: Remember that energy must be conserved in our system. Also remember that the problem states the surface is frictionless.

title: Conservation of Energy
text: There is no initial potential energy, so the equation to solve is $$KE_{\text{i}}=KE_{\text{f}}+PE_{\text{f}}$$.

title: Solve for $$v_f$$
text: Divide by the mass and solve $$\tfrac12v_i**2=\tfrac12v_f**2+gh$$ for the final speed $$v_f$$.
